features.name: home_asset_exposure_score
features.description: Blends home ownership, dwelling count, household size, and existing fire/property coverage into a bounded exposure score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth asset-oriented coordinate for a linear margin, reducing reliance on separate sparse policy indicators.

features.name: ownership_rental_balance
features.description: Signed normalized balance between owner-occupied and rented housing prevalence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear margin a direct direction for housing tenure rather than two opposing raw shares.

features.name: household_family_density_score
features.description: Combines marriage prevalence, children in household, average household size, and low single-person prevalence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a dense household-stability projection likely easier for a linear margin than several correlated ordinal fields.

features.name: income_affluence_projection
features.description: Weighted projection of income bands and average income onto a smooth affluence scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses multiple collinear income fields into one interpretable continuous coordinate.
features.formula: np.clip(0.70 * ((0.10 * incomeLessThan30k + 0.35 * income30To45k + 0.60 * income45To75k + 0.85 * income75To122k + 1.00 * incomeAbove123k) / 9.0) + 0.30 * (averageIncome / 9.0), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: car_mobility_score
features.description: Summarizes household car access and car policy engagement while penalizing high no-car prevalence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a continuous mobility dimension that can interact linearly with household and dwelling signals.

features.name: policy_count_engagement_log
features.description: Log-scaled count of existing non-excluded insurance relationships across common product groups.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces sparsity and outlier impact from policy counts into a smooth engagement measure.
features.formula: np.clip(np.log1p(numberOfPrivateThirdPartyInsurance + numberOfCarPolicies + numberOfFirePolicies + numberOfLifeInsurances + numberOfMopedPolicies + numberOfBicyclePolicies + numberOfMotorcycleScooterPolicies + numberOfTractorPolicies + numberOfTrailerPolicies + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceAgriculture + numberOfPropertyInsurancePolicies + numberOfSocialSecurityInsurancePolicies) / 3.0, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: contribution_intensity_log
features.description: Log-scaled total contribution intensity from major numeric contribution fields plus mapped private third-party contribution band.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures monetary commitment with diminishing returns, useful for robust linear separation.
features.formula: np.clip(np.log1p(contributionCarPolicies + contributionFirePolicies + contributionLifeInsurances + contributionMopedPolicies + contributionMotorcycleScooterPolicies + contributionTractorPolicies + contributionThirdPartyInsuranceAgriculture + contributionPropertyInsurancePolicies + contributionSocialSecurityInsurancePolicies + contributionBicyclePolicies + np.where(contributionPrivateThirdPartyInsurance == 'f 0', 0.0, np.where(contributionPrivateThirdPartyInsurance == 'f 1 - 49', 1.0, np.where(contributionPrivateThirdPartyInsurance == 'f 50 - 99', 3.0, np.where(contributionPrivateThirdPartyInsurance == 'f 100 - 199', 5.0, 0.0))))) / 3.5, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: property_fire_commitment_score
features.description: Combines fire and property policy counts and contribution levels into a focused dwelling-related portfolio signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights existing coverage patterns closest to residential asset protection in one smooth feature.

features.name: rural_agri_profile_score
features.description: Captures agricultural and rural orientation using farmer prevalence, farmer segment membership, and agricultural policy holdings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth domain-specific projection for areas where dwelling and vehicle patterns may differ from urban households.

features.name: age_midlife_stability_score
features.description: Maps age band to a smooth midlife household-stability score with moderate values for younger and older bands.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns an ordinal age band into a single monotone-friendly coordinate for linear modeling.
features.formula: np.where(avgAge == '20-30 years', 0.20, np.where(avgAge == '30-40 years', 0.70, np.where(avgAge == '40-50 years', 1.00, np.where(avgAge == '50-60 years', 0.90, np.where(avgAge == '60-70 years', 0.55, np.where(avgAge == '70-80 years', 0.30, 0.50))))))

features.name: semantic_segment_home_anchoring_score
features.description: Human or LLM assessor assigns 0.0 to 1.0 from customerSubtype and customerMainType text plus visible household and dwelling fields; higher means the row appears more settled and dwelling-centered. The scorer must use only visible row fields and training-fold code meanings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies an ordered semantic coordinate from segment text that raw category identifiers may not express linearly.

features.name: semantic_portfolio_coherence_score
features.description: Assessor rates 0.0 to 1.0 consistency between demographic profile and current insurance portfolio; higher when home ownership, household size, age, income, and existing fire/property/car coverages form a coherent long-term household profile.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures cross-field alignment that formula-only composites may miss, giving the margin a single expert-shaped direction.
